app_info.subtitle: QR codes for links & Wi-Fi
app_info.description: QR Code Studio generates standards-compliant QR codes for links, text, phone numbers, email, Wi-Fi networks and contact cards, shows them instantly in the conversation, and provides PNG and SVG downloads for print or screen.

justifications.read_only_justification: Encodes the supplied text into a QR image in memory and returns it; stores nothing and changes no data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Makes no network requests and does not touch any external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot delete, overwrite or send anything.

justifications.read_only_justification: Builds the WIFI: payload from the given network name and password and renders it; the credentials are only embedded in the returned image.
justifications.open_world_justification: Makes no network requests and does not connect to or configure any network.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot delete, overwrite or send anything.

justifications.read_only_justification: Formats the supplied contact fields as a vCard and renders it as a QR image; nothing is stored.
justifications.open_world_justification: Makes no network requests and does not touch any contact list or external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot delete, overwrite or send anything.

test_cases.description: Generate a QR code for a URL.
test_cases.user_prompt: Make a QR code for https://example.com/menu
test_cases.expected_output: A scannable QR code for the link is shown in the widget with PNG and SVG download buttons.

test_cases.user_prompt: Create a wifi QR code for my guest network 'CoffeeShop' with password latte123
test_cases.expected_output: A QR code encoding WIFI:T:WPA;S:CoffeeShop;P:latte123;; is shown; scanning it joins the network.

test_cases.user_prompt: QR code for my business card: Ada Lovelace, ada@example.com, +44 20 7946 0958, Analytical Engines Ltd
test_cases.expected_output: A vCard QR code is shown; scanning it opens 'Add contact' with the name, email, phone and organization filled in.

test_cases.description: Email QR with a prefilled subject.
test_cases.user_prompt: Make a QR code that opens an email to support@example.com with the subject 'Help'
test_cases.expected_output: A QR code encoding mailto:support@example.com?subject=Help is shown with downloads.

test_cases.description: Styled code with high error correction for print.
test_cases.user_prompt: I need a dark blue QR code for example.com with high error correction, 1024 px, for a poster
test_cases.expected_output: A QR code with #1a3a8a modules at error-correction level H is shown and the PNG download is 1024 px wide.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for reading or decoding a QR code.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What does this QR code in my photo say?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app is not invoked; it only generates codes and cannot decode images.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for barcodes or product codes.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Generate a UPC barcode for my product
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app is not invoked because it creates QR codes, not linear barcodes.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for general questions about QR codes.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: How do QR codes work and when were they invented?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: ChatGPT answers conversationally; no code is generated.
